notablePrerequisites:
Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Each opponent has a life total of two or greater.
description:
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal damage to each opponent equal to 3/2 their life total, and causing it to deal no damage to you due to Glacial Chasm.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
